page: Microsoft Azure E248ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine configured with 248 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel processors. It features 1888.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and includes 15118 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside compatibility with Premium Storage options.

The inclusion of a massive 15.1 TB local NVMe SSD provides high-capacity, low-latency temporary storage directly attached to the hypervisor host. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial local scratch space or high-speed caching. Because it lacks dedicated GPUs, parallel graphics or hardware-accelerated machine learning training workloads must rely on CPU-based execution.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E248ds_v7 offers high resource density by consolidating a massive memory footprint and extensive local storage onto a single virtual machine. This consolidation reduces the overhead of managing multiple smaller nodes. The server is engineered for large-scale enterprise workloads, including massive relational databases, in-memory analytics, large-scale data warehousing, and demanding enterprise resource planning systems.
